title: Tide
lines: Hits Ember bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Spark bosses for 25% less damage.
Tide hits leave Soaked on the boss. Spark cashes it in.

title: Ember
lines: Hits Grove bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Tide bosses for 25% less damage.
Ember hits leave Scorched on the boss. Tide cashes it in.

title: Grove
lines: Hits Spark bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Ember bosses for 25% less damage.
Grove hits leave Overgrown on the boss. Ember cashes it in.

title: Spark
lines: Hits Tide bosses for 50% more damage.
Hits Grove bosses for 25% less damage.
Spark hits leave Charged on the boss. Grove cashes it in.

title: Setter
short: Marks the boss for a combo.
lines: Its hit leaves its element's mark on the boss.
It can swap a mark of another element.
Other roles only mark a boss that has no mark.
Act before the creature that cashes the mark in.

title: Payoff
lines: A Payoff that sets off a reaction deals 10% more.
Any role can set off a reaction. Payoffs do it best.
Put it after a Setter that leaves the right mark.

title: Guard
short: Tough. Takes hits for its zone.
lines: Has 30% more HP than other roles.
A boss hit aimed at one creature goes to a Guard in the same zone.
Hits on a whole zone still reach everyone in it.
Best at the front, where the boss attacks first.

title: Support
lines: Each round it boosts the creatures right next to it.
Their next hit deals 15% more damage.
A knocked-out or silenced Support gives no boost.
Place it between your strongest hitters.

title: Soaked
short: Tide's mark. Spark cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Tide hit.
A Spark hit sets off Overload.
Only a Setter of another element can swap it.
It stays until it is cashed in or swapped.

title: Charged
short: Spark's mark. Grove cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Spark hit.
A Grove hit sets off Grounding.
Only a Setter of another element can swap it.
It stays until it is cashed in or swapped.

title: Overgrown
short: Grove's mark. Ember cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Grove hit.
A Ember hit sets off Wildfire.
Only a Setter of another element can swap it.
It stays until it is cashed in or swapped.

title: Scorched
short: Ember's mark. Tide cashes it in.
lines: Left on the boss by a Ember hit.
A Tide hit sets off Steam.
Only a Setter of another element can swap it.
It stays until it is cashed in or swapped.

title: Overload
lines: A Spark hit on a Soaked boss sets it off.
It deals 4.5 times the normal damage.
It uses up the mark. The next hit leaves a new one.
Any role can set it off. Payoffs deal 10% more.

title: Grounding
lines: A Grove hit on a Charged boss sets it off.
It deals 4.5 times the normal damage.
It uses up the mark. The next hit leaves a new one.
Any role can set it off. Payoffs deal 10% more.

title: Wildfire
lines: A Ember hit on a Overgrown boss sets it off.
It deals 4.5 times the normal damage.
It uses up the mark. The next hit leaves a new one.
Any role can set it off. Payoffs deal 10% more.

title: Steam
lines: A Tide hit on a Scorched boss sets it off.
It deals 4.5 times the normal damage.
It uses up the mark. The next hit leaves a new one.
Any role can set it off. Payoffs deal 10% more.

title: Zone attack
short: Hits every creature in one zone.
lines: Every living creature in that zone takes a hit.
A Guard cannot take it for the others.
A Shield Wall on that zone softens it.
The stage warns you one round ahead.

title: Silence
short: The row's ends skip a turn.
lines: The creatures at both ends of the row skip their next turn.
A silenced Support gives no boost.
Keep your best hitters away from the ends.
The stage warns you one round ahead.

title: Reflect
short: Turns a reaction back on you.
lines: The first reaction of the round hurts your creature, not the boss.
The boss only takes the normal hit. The mark is still used up.
Later reactions in the same round work as usual.

title: Strongest strike
lines: Hits the living creature with the highest Attack.
A Guard in its zone takes the hit instead.
A Shield Wall on that zone softens it.

title: Front
short: Closest to the boss. Hit first.
lines: The row is split into a front, a middle and a back part.
The boss's normal attack hits the front first.
When the front is knocked out, it moves on to the middle.
Guards belong here.

title: Middle
lines: Front and back get a third of the row each.
The middle gets whatever is left.
A row of 1 or 2 creatures is all middle.
The boss hits it once the front is down.

title: Back
short: Farthest from the boss. Hit last.
lines: The boss's normal attack reaches it last.
Zone attacks and tricks can still reach it.
Automatic placement puts Payoffs here.

title: Left to right
short: The row acts from slot 1 on.
lines: Creatures act in slot order, slot 1 first.
Put Setters before the creature that cashes in.
To repeat a reaction, alternate a Setter and a cashing creature.

title: Right to left
short: The row acts from the last slot.
lines: Creatures act in reverse slot order, the last slot first.
Put Setters before the creature that cashes in.
To repeat a reaction, alternate a Setter and a cashing creature.

title: By Speed
lines: Creatures act from highest Speed (SPD) to lowest.
With equal Speed, the lower slot goes first.
Check each creature's SPD on the Collection tab.

title: Auto fire
lines: On: an ability fires by itself in its round.
Tap Fire to use one sooner. It lands next round.
Off: it waits for you, and still fires in the last round.

title: Creature ability
short: A move for the live finale.
lines: Every species has its own ability.
It unlocks at level 10 and gets stronger when the creature evolves.
Up to 3 team creatures fire one each, plus your basic ability.
Each ability fires once.

title: Basic ability
lines: Pick Rally, Shield Wall, Re-mark or Purge before the finale.
It is weaker than a creature ability.
If you do not pick, one is chosen for you.

title: Rally
short: Rally: everyone hits harder for a while.
lines: Every creature's hits deal bonus damage.
It lasts for the number of rounds the ability says.
It adds up with Support boosts and other Rallies.

title: Shield Wall
short: Shield Wall: one zone takes less damage.
lines: Cuts the damage one zone takes, for the rounds the ability says.
Two walls on one zone stack.
Creature abilities shield their own creature's zone.
The stage warns you one round before a zone attack.

title: Re-mark
short: Re-mark: puts a mark on the boss.
lines: It replaces any mark the boss has.
Basic Re-mark lets you pick the element.
Creature abilities use their own element.
Then the right element can cash it in.

title: Purge
short: Purge: turns off the boss's counter-move.
lines: It switches the Phase 2 counter-move off for a few rounds.
It only matters once the boss has a counter-move.
When it ends, the boss adapts again.

title: Strike
short: Strike: hits the boss right away.
lines: The creature hits the boss at once for a share of its Attack.
It can cash in a mark like any other hit.
It still lands if the creature has been knocked out.

title: Boss Rank
short: How tough this week's boss is.
lines: Each Rank adds 40% more boss HP. Its Attack grows too.
Win a normal week's finale and the Rank goes up by 1.
Lose and the Rank stays the same.
Higher Ranks pay more Essence.

title: Festival
lines: Every 5th raid week is a Festival.
The boss fights 3 Ranks lower, and Essence pays 50% more.
Win the finale to win the Festival creature.
A win keeps the Rank. After a Festival, the Rank eases by 1.

title: Season
short: 5 raid weeks, ending in a Festival.
lines: A season is 5 raid weeks.
Weeks 1 to 4 are normal. Week 5 is the Festival.
The pips show where you are. The last pip is the Festival.
Then a new season begins.

title: Readiness
lines: A rough guess of how the finale could go.
It comes from a forecast. It is not a promise.
The words are Long shot, Even, Likely and Strong.

title: Long shot
short: Your team looks short for this boss.
lines: Train your creatures and set a better row to improve it.
A long shot can still win: combos and crits swing fights.

title: Even
lines: Your team looks about as ready as this boss is tough.
Combos and crits can tip it.

title: Likely
lines: A win looks likely for this boss.
It is not a promise: crits and boss tricks can surprise you.

title: Strong
lines: A win looks very likely for this boss.
It is still a forecast, not a promise.

title: Counter-move
lines: After Phase 1 the boss adapts to what worked best.
Reaction Resistance: your most used reaction does 50% less bonus damage.
Element Resistance: your top damage element does 25% less.
A Purge ability switches it off for a few rounds.

title: Essence
lines: Every raid stage you clear pays Essence.
Most of it is the same for all. The rest depends on how much you helped.
Higher Ranks and Festival weeks pay more.
Evolving costs 20 Essence (40 for rare creatures).

title: Bait
lines: Your leets in Discord turn into Bait.
Spend it to train creatures and fund expeditions.
Extra copies of a fully fused creature turn into Bait.

title: Training cost
lines: Going up one level costs 3 + 2 x its level, in Bait.
Level 1 to 2 costs 5 Bait. Level 10 to 11 costs 23.
Half price if the creature is more than 5 levels below the server's median.
A creature away on an expedition cannot train.

title: Level
lines: Train a creature with Bait to raise its level.
Each level adds HP, Attack and Speed.
A creature that can evolve stops at level 15 until it does. The top is 30.
At level 10 a creature gets its finale ability.

title: Critical hit
short: A lucky hit that does extra.
lines: Every hit has a 5% chance to be critical.
A critical hit does 50% more damage.
A few creatures crit more often, or harder.
The boss can crit too, with the same odds.

title: Fusion
lines: A duplicate catch fuses into the creature you already have.
Each fusion adds stats, up to 20% after 5 fusions.
The stars show your fusions. After 5, a duplicate gives Bait.

title: Rarity
short: How hard a creature is to find.
lines: Common, Rare or Epic.
Rarer creatures turn up less often on expeditions.
Better supplies improve the odds.

title: Shiny
lines: About 1 in 500 catches is shiny.
A shiny duplicate makes your creature shiny.
It is only for show. A shiny has the same stats.

title: Away
lines: It cannot be trained until it is back.
Claim or recall the expedition to bring it home.

title: First on server
short: Nobody here had it before you.
lines: You were the first on this server to get it.
Everyone who got it at the same moment shares the title.
